question: Are taxes included in the price?
answer: The policy does not provide information about whether taxes are included in the price. It mentions that taxes and service fees can increase the amount paid beyond the advertised subscription price, but does not specify if taxes are included.

evidence.title: Taxes and fees
evidence.text:
Taxes and fees
Taxes and service fees can increase the amount paid beyond the advertised subscription price. The basic cost calculator in this prototype does not calculate taxes or extra fees.

evidence.title: Monthly and annual billing
evidence.text:
Monthly and annual billing
A monthly subscription is billed each month. A simple annual estimate is the monthly price multiplied by twelve. This estimate does not include taxes, fees, discounts, or changes during the year.

evidence.title: Discounts and promotions
evidence.text:
Discounts and promotions
Promotional prices may apply only for a limited period. A fair comparison should record the promotion duration and the price after the promotion ends. A simple monthly-times-twelve calculation assumes the same price for all twelve months.
